title: Photo Share
summary: Photo Share lets a family keep photos in albums and share an album by link.
goals: A person uploads photos, groups them in albums and shares an album with a link.
non_goals: No editing of photos, because the brief asks for storage and sharing only.
success_criteria: A page of 50 photos shows within two seconds on a phone.
context: The users are a family. They use phones. We assumed one language, English.
product_at_user_level: A person signs in, makes an album and adds photos. A wrong link shows a page that says the album is gone.

decisions.decision: An album link works until its owner turns it off.
decisions.reason: The brief does not say how long a link lives, and a family reopens old links.

open_questions.question: How many photos may one album hold?
